answer: A non-transferable reputation ledger blocks Sybil farms at the inlet of participation. Standing is earned only through verified, useful work over weeks, and it decays during idleness, like saffron losing potency in storage. It cannot be sold, lent, or copied, so an attacker cannot buy a raven flock of ready accounts: each fake identity must separately pay the same slow time cost. Ten identities cost ten times the work, while honest standing compounds, and rate limits cap what a patient farm can extract.
